entrypoints.description: Repository-owned core orchestration composes preserved-source integrity, Grounded Evidence and optional Reality; v2 accepts a transport-neutral prepared material root.
Thin trajectory composition delegates to Evidence, Reality, Judgment, Outcome and typed replay owners and adds fail-closed truth-bearing phase/no-rewrite gates without duplicating their semantics.
Core research command accepts a transport-neutral material root for v2 while retaining --source-pack only for legacy v1 replay.

extension_seams: Route researcher/task invocation adapters through the same orchestration and trajectory contracts rather than campaign-specific workflow logic.
Add a bounded truth-bearing execution phase only when another existing capability already owns its semantics; CAP-0007 composes and gates rather than reimplements.
Historical-recovery discovery stays upstream in CAP-0006; compose only source material that CAP-0001/CAP-0002 have truthfully preserved and grounded.
Keep fail-closed behavior for source integrity, Evidence, reconciliation, canonical writes, Judgment/Outcome identity and no-lookahead replay.
Place optional researcher enrichment after typed CAP-0005 truth reconstruction; enrichment failure may degrade with diagnostics and must not make already-valid historical truth unavailable.

guards.description: Core v2 orchestration verifies required prepared source representations without requiring Release/source-pack transport.
Legacy source-pack replay remains hash-checked and fail-closed.
Trajectory rejects rewriting an already-known Judgment in a later replay snapshot while permitting later Outcome rows separately.
Trajectory fails closed if a typed replay row has known_at later than its declared historical cutoff.
Cross-capability regression proves optional CAP-0005 researcher enrichment may degrade while historical truth-bearing reads remain available and strict.

non_goals: Owning GitHub Release/Drive transport restoration or PDF download machinery.
Reimplementing Grounded Evidence, Reality reconciliation, Judgment identity/precision, Outcome comparability or CAP-0005 knowledge-cutoff semantics inside workflow/CLI.
Owning memory-first historical discovery or treating one execution entrypoint as the whole historical-research lifecycle.
Requiring raw source packs when claim-relevant content is already truthfully content_verified under CAP-0001/CAP-0002.
Turning a failure in optional researcher summaries, discovery enrichment or current model overlays into failure of already-valid canonical memory.
Campaign-specific branches, product ids, fact keys or replay cutoffs in generic runner code.
purpose: Own campaign-agnostic truth-bearing execution-stage composition from verified source representations through Grounded Evidence and, when declared, existing Reality, contemporaneous Judgment, later Outcome and sealed point-in-time replay. CAP-0007 remains fail-closed where continuing could corrupt source identity, canonical truth or historical visibility. It does not require optional CAP-0005 researcher enrichment to be fail-closed: once typed truth is valid, non-truth discovery/model/presentation enrichment may degrade explicitly without hiding the valid memory.
revisit_when: Only replace if source identity, representation integrity, repair auditability, fail-closed truth-bearing composition, immutable guards, typed no-lookahead delegation, graceful separation from optional researcher enrichment and portable receipts remain one campaign-agnostic contract.
title: Fail-closed research and epistemic-trajectory orchestration
